What this does and does not establish

The community tests orchestration under declared behavior assumptions. It uses scheduled turns and isolated database aging, not a real-time 30-day soak. Discovery order includes server randomness, so this captured event log is the exact replay; the seed alone cannot reproduce every candidate ordering.

Model cases test approved-fact screening against known fixture incompatibilities. An eligibility-only baseline would nominate every diagnostic pair because their coarse criteria match. Four cases repeated twice are too few to estimate population accuracy. Neither simulated consent nor an agent YES predicts human chemistry.

Pending: real Stripe sandbox payment and webhook delivery, real mailbox delivery, a wall-clock restart/soak campaign, large-scale model interviews, and real-user willingness to pay. June remains disabled. These are not counted as passes.

All identities and transcripts in this report are fictional. Raw artifacts and the exact campaign source remain in the workspace.
